title: 2023 HMMT November Guts Problem 4
statement: The number 5.6 may be expressed uniquely (ignoring order) as a product \(\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b} \times \underline{c} . \underline{d}\) for digits \(a, b, c, d\) all nonzero. Compute \(\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b}+\underline{c} \cdot \underline{d}\).

solutions.text: We want \(\overline{a b} \times \overline{c d}=560=2^{4} \times 5 \times 7\). To avoid a zero digit, we need to group the 5 with the 7 to get 3.5 and 1.6 , and our answer is \(3.5+1.6=5.1\).
